```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(dotenv)
library(here)
library(tibble)

env_file = here(".env")
load_dot_env(file = env_file)
```

```{r}
SERVER_PATH <- Sys.getenv("SERVER_PATH")
```

```{r}
cdi_level1 <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level1.csv"))
cdi_level2a <- read.csv(file.path(SERVER_PATH, "data/raw/lookit/cdi/cdi_level2a.csv"))
words_row <- cdi_level1[1,]
#delete unnecessary columns
cdi1_cleaned <- cdi_level1 |> slice(-(1:11)) |> filter(Finished == 1) |> rename(duration_in_seconds = Duration..in.seconds.) |> select(ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
cdi2a_cleaned <- cdi_level2a |> slice(-(1:8)) |> filter(Finished == 1)  |> rename(duration_in_seconds = Duration..in.seconds.) |> select(ChildID, starts_with("Q"))
```

```{r}
# It seems like the forth row in cdi2a should be excluded because it is impossible for a children that often combine words to say so little words
# A function to filter out such impossible combination should be written
cdi2a_cleaned <- cdi2a_cleaned |> slice(-4)
```

```{r}
#get a mapping table
words <- words_row |> select(starts_with("Q")) |> pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Q")) |> separate(value, into=c('WordType', 'Words'), sep='-') |> mutate(WordType = trimws(WordType), Words = trimws(Words))
```

```{r}
# transform to pivot long for df1
cdi1_long <- cdi1_cleaned |> pivot_longer(cols=!ChildID, names_to = "Question", values_to = 'Response') |> mutate(Response = trimws(Response), Response = na_if(Response, ""), Response = as.numeric(Response)) |>
  #add survey type and value
  mutate(SurveyType = 1,
         Value = ifelse(is.na(Response), 0, 1))
```

```{r}
#check before merge words to df1_long
setdiff(cdi1_long$Question, words$name)

#map into condition
ability <- tibble::tibble(Response = c(NA, 1, 2), Type = c(NA, 'understands', 'produces'))

#merge conditions and words
cdi1_merged <- cdi1_long %>% left_join(words, c('Question' = 'name')) |> left_join(ability, 'Response') 

# if type = produces; add type = understands row with value = 1
# if type = understands; add type = produces row with value = 0
# if type = NA ; update type = produces row with value = 0 AND type = understands row with value = 0
# maybe use fill function in R?
```

```{r}
cdi1_complete <- cdi1_merged |>
  # keep both ability types for every item
  complete(
    nesting(Question,ChildID, Words, WordType, SurveyType),
    Type = c("understands", "produces")
  ) %>%
  # fill missing values
  mutate(
    Value = case_when(
      Type == "understands" & is.na(Value) ~ 0,
      Type == "produces" & is.na(Value) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ Value
    )
  ) %>%
  # if produces == 1, understands should also == 1
  group_by(Question, ChildID) %>%
  mutate(
    Value = ifelse(
      Type == "understands" &
      any(Type == "produces" & Value == 1),
      1,
      Value
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#process df2 similar to df1
cdi2a_long <- cdi2a_cleaned |> 
  pivot_longer(c(Q1, Q2), names_to = 'Question_group', values_to = 'Response') |>
  separate_rows(Response, sep=',') |> 
  mutate(
    Response = trimws(Response), 
    Response = na_if(Response, ""), 
    Response = as.numeric(Response), 
    Says = 1L
    ) |>
  select("ChildID", "Question_group", "Response", "Says")
```

```{r}
# Let df2 contain both selected and non-selected entries
cdi2a_all <- cdi2a_long |> distinct(ChildID) |> crossing(words2a)

# Make complete cdi2a dataframe
cdi2a_complete <- cdi2a_all |> left_join(cdi2a_long, by=c('ChildID', 'Question_group', 'Response')) |>
  mutate(Says = coalesce(Says, 0L)) |> distinct()
```

```{r}
# add Q3
Q3_mapping <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Question_group, ~Response, ~Response_label,
  'Q3', 1, "Not Yet",
  'Q3', 2, "Sometimes",
  'Q3', 3, "Often"
)

cdi2a_Q3 <- cdi2a_cleaned |>
  select(ChildID, Q3) |> 
  pivot_longer(Q3, names_to = 'Question_group', values_to = 'Response') |>
  mutate("Response" = as.numeric(Response)) |>
  left_join(Q3_mapping, by=c('Question_group', 'Response'))
  
cdi2a_complete <- bind_rows(cdi2a_complete, cdi2a_Q3)

#add survey type, word type, and value column
cdi2a_complete$SurveyType = '2A'
cdi2a_complete$Value = 
  ifelse(
    cdi2a_complete$Question_group=="Q3", 
    ifelse(is.na(cdi2a_complete$Response), 0, 1), 
    cdi2a_complete$Says
    ) 
cdi2a_complete$WordType = 
  ifelse(
    cdi2a_complete$Question_group != "Q3",
    ifelse(cdi2a_complete$Question_group=="Q1", "extra_words", "cdi_words"),
    NA
)
```
